summary: Resolve opaque managed-session owners through indexed identity candidates and exact incarnation validation

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; exact validation retains snapshot and incarnation fencing.

schema.detail: Adds claims_agent_session_identity_index for narrow identity candidates. No schema-version bump, table change or data rewrite. The index covers agent claims with root or nested incarnation/runtime fields while excluding non-status claim kinds.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Existing session IDs, owner routing, protocols and scopes are unchanged. Candidate identities are not authority: a matching candidate is validated against exact subject history and origin at the requested snapshot.

downtime.detail: First startup builds the additive identity index. Large-store index creation and restart-to-API/health milestones have not been measured; allow startup time for index creation.

manual.detail: No operator actions or client re-pairing required; the index is created automatically on store open and identity/state are preserved.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back is supported with unchanged schema and rules versions; older binaries ignore the additive index, which does not alter stored claims.
